name: lf/agent-prompt
title: Agent Prompt
description: A dropdown that opens a pre-filled prompt in Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants, with a "Copy prompt" fallback.

label.default: Discuss the program with your agent

prompt.default: For the event described at [Event homepage URL], help me plan my schedule to make the most of the event. You can see the schedule here: [Sessionize schedule markdown url] and instructions on how to use the Sessionize schedule app here: https://events.linuxfoundation.org/sessionize-app-experience/. Ask me follow-up questions if needed. Include direct links to relevant website pages.
